task.objective: Half my outlets just died, can someone come today

injected_behaviors.instructions: The user is anxious about the outage and repeatedly presses for speed — asking 'how soon can they get here?' and 'is that the fastest option?' after each assistant message. She takes her students on nature walks, runs after-school science club, and designs hands-on experiments that get kids excited about how things work. She's always looking for new ways to make abstract concepts tangible and relevant to her students' lives.
